integrity: Analytic infinite-parameter proof supplemented by exact rational interval certificate; external independent assessment not performed.
limitations: Theorem gives existence of prime-two cycles on 4/25<c<3-2sqrt(2), and a locally attracting example only at c=1/6. No full global classification or equality-threshold stability. Inaccessible or unindexed strategically equivalent older results may exist.
title: An interior attracting cycle and a sharp local instability threshold in asymmetric lottery contests
